newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-GIL BANNED FOR THREE MONTHS AFTER OUTBURST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GIL BANNED FOR THREE MONTHS AFTER OUTBURST.

text.p: Atletico Madrid president Jesus Gil was suspended for three months by the Spanish Football Federation on Thursday for an outburst following his side's controversial league defeat to Real Betis earlier this year.
Gil had lashed out at football authorities and referees in March after the 3-2 defeat at Real Betis, in which two Atletico players were sent off.
The red cards meant both players were suspended for the Spanish Cup quarter-final against Barcelona.
Gil threatened to withdraw his side from the Cup, and only let the team travel to Barcelona at the last minute. Atletico finally went down 5-4 in an epic game which they had led at one stage 3-0.
